voice.instructions: Narrate a software product demo. Clear, warm and confident, at a steady, slightly brisk pace. Natural intonation, no dramatic pauses.

beats.say: Docs change with every release.
beats.cap: Docs change with every release.

beats.say: Translations don't. They fall behind.
beats.cap: Translations don't. They fall behind.

beats.say: Or someone re-translates a page, and a command quietly breaks.
beats.cap: Or someone re-translates a page, and a command quietly breaks.

beats.say: This is Doc Twin.
beats.cap: This is DocTwin.

beats.say: A set of OpenMinion agents that keep translated docs in sync with the English source,
beats.cap: OpenMinion agents that keep translated docs in sync with the English source,

beats.say: without breaking a single command, link, or code block.
beats.cap: without breaking a single command, link, or code block.

beats.say: Here is how a sync works.
beats.cap: Here is how a sync works.

beats.say: Doc Twin splits the docs into sections and checks a ledger, so only the sections that changed go to the model.
beats.cap: It splits the docs into sections and checks a ledger. Only changed sections go to the model.

beats.say: Code, links and inline commands are replaced by placeholders the model cannot touch.
beats.cap: Code, links and inline commands become placeholders the model cannot touch.

beats.say: A translator agent does the writing.
beats.cap: A translator agent does the writing.

beats.say: Deterministic gates check structure, numbers and glossary terms.
beats.cap: Deterministic gates check structure, numbers and glossary terms.

beats.say: A skeptical reviewer subagent checks the meaning.
beats.cap: A skeptical reviewer subagent checks the meaning.

beats.say: And Doc Drift, our validator, checks every command against the real S D K.
beats.cap: And DocDrift, our validator, checks every command against the real SDK.

beats.say: Let's run it for real, on G P T four point one mini. What you see is a screen recording.
beats.cap: Let's run it for real, on gpt-4.1-mini. What you see is a screen recording.

beats.say: One sentence changed in the English docs. The plan finds it: one section out of fifty-four.
beats.cap: One sentence changed in the English docs. The plan finds it: 1 section out of 54.

beats.say: Now the sync. The translator and the reviewer run as OpenMinion agents.
beats.cap: Now the sync. The translator and the reviewer run as OpenMinion agents.

beats.say: Thirty-two seconds later: one section translated, fifty-three reused, code blocks identical, and no broken commands.
beats.cap: 32 seconds later: 1 section translated, 53 reused, code blocks identical, no broken commands.

beats.say: Here is the section it wrote. The new sentence is there, and the code block is byte for byte the same.
beats.cap: The new sentence is there, and the code block is byte for byte the same.

beats.say: Three guardrails keep it honest.
beats.cap: Three guardrails keep it honest.

beats.say: One: the gates. In our first full sync, the model rewrote thirty-three point seven six as thirty-three comma seven six, the Indonesian decimal style.
beats.cap: One: the gates. In our first sync, the model rewrote 33.76 as 33,76.

beats.say: The number gate refused it, so that section stayed in English instead of shipping a wrong value.
beats.cap: The number gate refused it, so that section stayed in English instead of shipping a wrong value.

beats.say: Two: approval. A new glossary term is written only when a human approves it.
beats.cap: Two: approval. A new glossary term is written only when a human approves it.

beats.say: Here, one term is approved and one is denied, and only the approved one reaches the file.
beats.cap: Here, one term is approved and one is denied. Only the approved one reaches the file.

beats.say: Three: human edits. When a person edits a translated file, Doc Twin notices and leaves it alone.
beats.cap: Three: human edits. When a person edits a translated file, DocTwin notices and leaves it alone.

beats.say: We proved it on OpenMinion's own docs, translated into Bahasa Indonesia.
beats.cap: We proved it on OpenMinion's own docs, translated into Bahasa Indonesia.

beats.say: Moving from version zero point one point eighteen to zero point one point twenty-three, only fourteen of fifty-four sections went to the model.
beats.cap: From v0.1.18 to v0.1.23, only 14 of 54 sections went to the model.

beats.say: The other forty were reused, untouched.
beats.cap: The other 40 were reused, untouched.

beats.say: Under the hood, it is all OpenMinion:
beats.cap: Under the hood, it is all OpenMinion:

beats.say: agents with typed outputs, a read-only glossary tool,
beats.cap: agents with typed outputs, a read-only glossary tool,

beats.say: an approval callback on the one tool that writes, forced tools, and a reviewer subagent.
beats.cap: an approval callback on the one tool that writes, forced tools, and a reviewer subagent.

beats.say: Building it also improved OpenMinion itself.
beats.cap: Building it also improved OpenMinion itself.

beats.say: We found that validation errors were hiding their real cause, and reported it.
beats.cap: We found that validation errors were hiding their real cause, and reported it.

beats.say: The maintainers confirmed it and merged our fix, and it shipped in OpenMinion zero point one point twenty-four.
beats.cap: The maintainers confirmed it and merged our fix. It shipped in OpenMinion 0.1.24.

beats.say: We also reported that a message longer than twelve thousand characters comes back as a canned reply marked completed, and proposed a fix.
beats.cap: We also reported a canned reply for messages over 12,000 characters, and proposed a fix.

beats.say: We tested Cortensor Portal and Gemma four too.
beats.cap: We tested Cortensor Portal and Gemma4 too.

beats.say: Called directly, the A P I works, including tool calls.
beats.cap: Called directly, the API works, including tool calls.

beats.say: Full agent turns did not complete yet: we hit intermittent stalls and a gateway five oh two.
beats.cap: Full agent turns did not complete yet: we hit intermittent stalls and a gateway 502.

beats.say: Every run is logged with its request I D for the Cortensor team.
beats.cap: Every run is logged with its request ID for the Cortensor team.

beats.say: Doc Twin.
beats.cap: DocTwin.

beats.say: Translated docs that stay in sync, and stay correct. Built on OpenMinion.
beats.cap: Translated docs that stay in sync, and stay correct. Built on OpenMinion.
